propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and activated DET criteria to disappear; a single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must be compiled once from repository root and operation inputs and consumed by all gates.

Code-review project LLM criteria must require non-empty applies_to as non-empty repository-relative globs, with applies_to: ["**"] selecting unconditionally (including on empty changed_files), while plan-review criteria and other gates retain backward-compatible empty-list permission via shared _validate_applies_to.

CriteriaSnapshot must compose existing immutable-authority machinery (OperationSnapshot, shared criteria delegation, _overlay_signature digest) rather than duplicate it, with snapshot digest reusing/extending _overlay_signature.

Contract tests must prove snapshot equivalence to current behavior when no overlay is present, validate effective disables/retunes/DET inclusion, and explicitly assert applies_to: ["**"] selection on empty changed_files to preserve prior ungated behavior.
Migration of project.review-phase-boundaries from applies_to: [] to applies_to: ["**"] must preserve repository-wide review membership including empty-changed-files case, verified by contract test.
Snapshot is data and policy only; existing registry APIs remain as compatibility adapters, and rollback is code revert without configuration flags.
